title: Implement workspace dedupe in Rust
description:
## Goal
Make the same workspace-deduplication Gherkin scenarios pass in the Rust implementation (`rust/`), with observable behavior identical to the Python implementation.

## Scope
- Implement deduplication of discovered issues keyed by issue identity, keeping the most recently changed version per the semantics fixed by the spec task.
- List output (formatting and order) must match Python for the same inputs.
- Do not change Virtuus; this is Kanbus application logic only.

## Done when
- Rust cucumber scenarios for workspace deduplication pass.
- CLI output parity with Python holds for the deduplicated list.
